findings.title: Boss defeat can omit cooldown and retain reusable form at director cooldown capacity
findings.impact: A valid 99-key save can form a boss, then reach 100 keys at the next daily tick. Defeat skips cooldown and world consequence after granting victory rewards, while the retained form bypasses cooldown. A defeat immediately before midnight can add key 101 and create a save that reload rejects.
reproduction_steps: Create a valid Save 8 / Reward 3 state with 99 unique non-content-boss cooldown keys and quietUntil covering the next daily tick.
Meet Slime boss predicates and form slime_heart while at 99 keys.
Preserve the boss form across midnight; director:lastDailyTick becomes key 100. Saving and reloading remains accepted.
At a later eligible spawn time, defeat the boss; recorder returns false, but combat commits victory and retains bossForms.
Query/start again; the stored form bypasses cooldown and is reused.
findings.recommendation: Keep the map at or below 100 while guaranteeing a complete boss defeat outcome across intervening daily ticks. Do not commit victory rewards while silently skipping the consequence/cooldown or retaining a reusable form. Cover 99-to-100 persistence, exact-cap defeat, over-cap boundary, and atomicity.

findings.title: Outdoor authored-family wins advance dungeon stage and eventually make the save unloadable
findings.impact: Each outdoor content victory enters the dungeon progression branch. After three wins it increments dungeon.runs, emits a false dungeon clear, and grants iron. A fourth can put dungeon.stage above the valid maximum; deserialize then rejects the save.
reproduction_steps: Start from a normal state with dungeon.stage=0 and dungeon.inDungeon=false.
Win three forest Slime encounters through encounterContentMonster and combatTurn; each increments dungeon.stage, and the third emits a dungeon clear and grants dungeon iron.
Win a fourth outdoor content encounter; dungeon.stage becomes DUNGEON.encounters.length+1.
Serialize and reload; save validation rejects the out-of-range dungeon stage.
findings.recommendation: Keep authored-family outdoor payouts outside both the Goblin-threat branch and the dungeon progression branch; preserve dungeon progression only for actual dungeon combats. Assert all dungeon state and legacy inventory rewards remain unchanged across repeated content victories and verify reload.
